header.function_name: XD10 ASN Cross Dock Creation Screen

objective: To get the crossdock customer orders for a Delivery Date and Rit and pre-map them to supplier POs ([Search], XD09 Mapping Customer Order and PO Batch).

To display the delivery plan per Part Number + Customer Order Date at case level (Case Qty, PO Readiness, ASN Status Ready / Not Ready). Units already Created or without any ready case are not listed.
To let the D/S team (super admin) see the units of all suppliers, the destination detail and hold / release a destination of a unit.
To select one or more Ready units of one Supplier Code + Supplier Plant, map them to their POs (TB_R_INSTRUCTION), review the cases, download the case labels and submit the ASN.
Submit ASN runs in the background with a Submit ID and follows the existing ASN submit of NSP (refer 5.7).

buttons.name: Search
buttons.function: Run XD09 (Mapping Customer Order and PO): get the customer orders and pre-map them to POs for the chosen Delivery Date and Rit; display the delivery plan.

buttons.function: D/S team only: show / hide the customer order lines of a destination (Customer Order No, Detailed Item No, Qty, PO No, PO Date).

buttons.name: Hold / Release (D/S)
buttons.function: D/S team only: set HOLD_FLAG of every order line of the destination (part number + customer order date + destination) to 'Y' (hold) or 'N' (release).

buttons.name: Create ASN
buttons.function: Check that the selected units are of one supplier and not held, map them to their POs (insert TB_R_INSTRUCTION) and open the Case List sub screen.

buttons.name: Back
buttons.function: Return from the Case List to ASN Crossdock Creation without submitting; the rows of TB_R_INSTRUCTION are deleted and the mapping is released.

buttons.name: PO detail (expand)
buttons.function: Show / hide PO No, Manifest No, Manifest Item and PO Qty of a case.

buttons.name: Download Case Label
buttons.function: Download the labels of all cases of the ASN. Label format follows the existing case label: 1 case label = 1 case of 1 destination, may list several customer order numbers.

buttons.name: Submit ASN
buttons.function: Ask for confirmation, then hand the ASN to the submit process with a Submit ID (refer 5.7); the result is written to the log.

buttons.name: Yes / No
buttons.function: Confirmation of Submit ASN (Submit? Y / N).

screen_mode_remarks: 1) The check box of a unit is enabled only when its ASN Status is Ready (message no. 1 or 2 as tooltip otherwise).
2) Units of different Customer Order Dates and Part Numbers can be ticked together; each unit always goes into the ASN as a whole.
3) The expand buttons and Hold / Release are shown to the D/S team only; the supplier sees the header (case level) only.
4) Search is enabled when Delivery Date is filled and a Rit is available (message no. 5 otherwise).
5) One ASN is for one Supplier Code + Supplier Plant: the D/S team may tick units of several suppliers, [Create ASN] then shows message no. 9.

items: On first display Delivery Date = today (business date), Rit = first rit of the date, Route displayed (disabled). The delivery plan is empty.

[Search] runs XD09 Mapping Customer Order and PO Batch (UISS XD09): customer orders of H0253 with order status 7, Hold Flag N, not mapped, earliest order date first per part number (FIFO), pre-mapped to the PO parts of the Pra Daily Order (FIFO PO date) in the temporary table #TEMP_INSTRUCTION (pre-mapping only; nothing is saved yet). Supplier: units of the login Supplier Code + Plant; D/S team: all suppliers.

The delivery plan shows one row per Part Number + Customer Order Date, sorted Ready, Not Ready, then Part Number ascending. Units with PO Readiness 0 and units already Created (in a submitted ASN) are not listed. Part Number and Status filters apply at once. No row: message no. 3.
Delivery Date and Rit do not filter the orders; they are carried to the ASN. Rit and Route come from the existing route master table.

Unit = Part Number + Customer Order Date. Case = destination x pcs/case: the qty of a destination is packed in cases of pcs/case (e.g. Vietnam 24 pcs, 6 pcs/case = 4 cases). G-TOPAS releases in multiples of pcs/case (a remainder stays pending and is not in H0253), so every case is full. A case can hold several customer orders and several POs of the same destination; a customer order line that does not fit in the remaining space of a case continues in the next case (e.g. case 3 = CO-14001 4 + CO-14006 2 of PO2; case 4 = CO-14006 2 of PO2 + CO-14007 4 of PO4).
Case Qty = number of destinations. PO Readiness (case) = cases whose whole qty is pre-mapped to a PO.

Ready ('6'): every line of the unit is pre-mapped to a PO. Not Ready ('7'): at least one line of the unit has no PO yet (check box disabled, message no. 2). With POs of different PO Dates the unit becomes Ready when the last PO is available (condition 3).
Created: the unit is in a submitted ASN (ASN status '1'); it is no longer listed (shown in ASN Inquiry).

The D/S team can expand a unit: one row per destination with Case, Qty (pcs), Pcs/Case and Hold Flag; each destination can be expanded to its customer order lines (Customer Order No, Detailed Item No, Qty, PO No, PO Date). The supplier sees the header only.

Hold / Release is done per destination: it updates HOLD_FLAG of every order line of the unit and destination in TB_R_H0253_ORDER_CONTROL_PRE (refer Data Edit Mapping). A held destination is not taken by Search; the unit is computed without it. A unit with all destinations on hold is shown as On Hold to the D/S team only.
HOLD_FLAG is 'N' when the line is first replicated (XD08) and is kept on the next replications.

The user ticks one or more Ready units, also of different Customer Order Dates and Part Numbers. A unit is never split. One ASN is for one Supplier Code + Supplier Plant (existing rule): ticked units of more than one supplier give message no. 9 and nothing is created.

[Create ASN] does the real mapping of the selected units in one transaction: PO_MAPPED_FLAG = 'Y' on their H0253 lines, MAPPED_QTY in the new table TB_R_PRA_DAILY_ORDER_MAPPED, and the mapping rows inserted into TB_R_INSTRUCTION (one case per Part Number + Customer Order Date + destination). Then the Case List opens.

Before mapping, the ticked units are re-checked in the same transaction (row lock on the H0253 lines): if a line got HOLD_FLAG = 'Y' after the unit was ticked (e.g. the D/S team held a destination in another session), the creation fails for the whole selection (also the units that are not held): message no. 8 (Hold), the delivery plan is refreshed automatically and all ticked units are unticked. If a unit is no longer Ready for another reason (changed by another user), message no. 7.
[Back] / [Cancel] on the Case List cancel the creation: the rows are deleted from TB_R_INSTRUCTION, PO_MAPPED_FLAG back to 'N' and MAPPED_QTY reduced again, so the units can be selected again.
The summary shows ASN No (assigned on submit), supplier, Delivery Date · Rit · Route of the Search, Delivery Qty (pcs) and number of cases.
Each case shows Case Number, Part Number and Qty; the expand shows PO No, Manifest No, Manifest Item and PO Qty. Customer order data is not shown here.
[Download Case Label]: follows the existing case label of NSP.

[Submit ASN]: confirmation (message no. 4). Yes: the draft is handed with a Submit ID to the submit process (refer 5.7); the submit process follows the existing ASN. It reads TB_R_INSTRUCTION and inserts the existing tables TB_R_DAILY_ORDER_MANIFEST (status Created) and TB_R_DAILY_ORDER_PART; ASN No and Case No follow the existing numbering (case number auto generated by checking the last sequence). The screen returns to the delivery plan and shows the Submit ID (message no. 6); there is no success popup. The result message is written by the submit process (5.7) to the existing log (Log Monitoring).

#TEMP_INSTRUCTION is temporary (pre-mapping of [Search]). TB_R_INSTRUCTION holds the mapping from [Create ASN] until submit or Back / Cancel. TB_R_PRA_DAILY_ORDER_MAPPED is a new table for the mapped qty. Submitted ASNs are in TB_R_DAILY_ORDER_MANIFEST / PART and shown in ASN Inquiry (XD15).
Case number: the format follows the existing NSP case number; the last sequence is kept in the existing last sequence table (note only, not detailed here).
Cancel of an order is not done in NSP: it comes from the source (H0253 order status '2'); NSP only holds (HOLD_FLAG). Refer XD11 / XD12.
The prototype has a 'Business date' switch (PO release) and a 'View as' switch (Supplier / D/S team); they are not part of the real screen.

operation.text: 5.7 Submit ASN Process (backend, follows the existing ASN)

items: The screen generates the Submit ID, writes the start message to the log (LOG2) and starts the submit process. The screen returns to the delivery plan and shows the Submit ID.

Read the rows of the Submit ID from TB_R_INSTRUCTION (one Supplier Code + Plant). Take the ASN No from the existing numbering and auto generate one Case No per case by checking the last sequence (existing last sequence table; format as existing).
Insert TB_R_DAILY_ORDER_MANIFEST (status Created) and TB_R_DAILY_ORDER_PART (existing tables, refer Data Edit Mapping); write ASN_NO / CASE_NO back to TB_R_INSTRUCTION.

No error: commit, write the result (LOG3) and end (LOG4) messages. Error: roll back, release the mapping (delete the rows from TB_R_INSTRUCTION, PO_MAPPED_FLAG back to 'N', MAPPED_QTY of TB_R_PRA_DAILY_ORDER_MAPPED reduced again), write the error (LOG5). Exit.
Submit ASN runs as a batch so the screen does not wait; the user sees the Submit ID and checks the result in Log Monitoring. No success popup is shown on the screen.
The log follows the existing NSP log (same table and columns); the Submit ID is the key to find the run.
All-or-nothing: on error nothing is saved and the mapping made by [Create ASN] is released (rows deleted from TB_R_INSTRUCTION), so the units can be selected again.

The ASN is saved in the existing tables TB_R_DAILY_ORDER_MANIFEST / TB_R_DAILY_ORDER_PART; the case number is auto generated by checking the last sequence kept in the existing last sequence table (format as existing, not detailed here).
The submit process (Submit ID, batch call, log) follows the existing ASN submit of NSP.
Dummy example of [Create ASN] (case packing, TB_R_INSTRUCTION rows, flags, Case List, scenarios): see sheet Sample Input.

tables.name: #TEMP_INSTRUCTION
tables.description: Temporary table of one Search run (session): customer order line (H0253, order status 7, Hold Flag N, not mapped) pre-mapped to a supplier PO (Pra Daily Order), FIFO by order date. One row per line x PO, plus one row with PO_NO NULL for the qty still without a PO. Columns proposed.

Order date of the PO (PO Date)
Order qty of the PO part

intro: Dummy data. Supplier 50221 plant 1, Delivery Date 16-Oct-2026, Rit 1, Route SD01. Pcs/Case = 6 for PART-X and PART-Y.
The supplier ticks PART-X 14-Oct-2026 and PART-Y 14-Oct-2026 (both Ready) on the delivery plan and clicks [Create ASN].

Rule: per Part Number + Customer Order Date + destination the order lines (FIFO, then by PO) are packed in cases of pcs/case. A case can hold several customer orders and several POs of the same destination; a line that does not fit continues in the next case.

sections.title: A. Input: pre-mapping of the ticked units (XD09, #TEMP_INSTRUCTION, one row per customer order line x PO)
B. Input: PO parts before [Create ASN] (Pra Daily Order: manifest with CROSS_DOCK_FLAG = 'X', part data from TB_R_PRA_DAILY_ORDER_PART)
C. Case packing (Vietnam 18 pcs = 3 cases, Thailand 6 pcs = 1 case, Philippines 6 pcs = 1 case)
D. Result: rows inserted into TB_R_INSTRUCTION (one row per case x customer order line x PO; ASN_NO / CASE_NO filled on submit)
E. Result: other tables changed in the same transaction
F. Result on the screen: Case List (Draft)
rows: Case Number, Part Number, Qty (6 each); the expand button shows the PO No, Manifest No, Manifest Item and PO Qty of the case (Case 2: CO-14101 + CO-14102 of T0409001; Case 3: CO-14102 + CO-14103 of T0409002)
Confirmation: Submit ASN? 5 cases (30 pcs) will be created into ASN-50221-261016-001, delivery 16-Oct-2026 · Rit 1.
